Job Description
AI Talent is seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to become a key part of our expanding team. In this role, you’ll act as the crucial link between development and operations, driving the automation and optimisation of our deployment processes. You will collaborate with developers to streamline CI/CD pipelines, enhance system reliability, and ensure secure, scalable infrastructure throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Experience:
- Minimum 6 years of full-time experience in a DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Systems Engineering role.
Skills:
- Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for rapid and reliable software delivery.
- Automate software build, test and deployment processes using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
- Monitor system performance, availability and security across environments using industry-standard tools.
- Write and maintain scripts for infrastructure automation and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Bash).
- Collaborate with developers and QA to troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
- Conduct root cause analysis, implement preventative measures, and optimise system processes.
- Maintain detailed technical documentation including deployment guides, monitoring plans and recovery procedures.
- Perform security assessments, manage encryption protocols, and support compliance audits.
- Contribute to the development of internal tools to improve efficiency, system visibility, and automation.
- Drive continuous integration, delivery, and improvement strategies across the SDLC.
Requirements:
- Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
- Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to high standards.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and documentation skills.
- Certified in relevant DevOps or cloud technologies (e.g. AWS, Azure, TOSCA, Kubernetes, ServiceNow Admin).
- Experience with tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Selenium, and ServiceNow.
Job Details:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
Work Authorisation: Australia (Required)

Job description

Australia Network Services Pty Ltd (ANS) is seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Software Engineer for our client operating in the software development, IT services, and digital solutions industry in Sydney, Australia.

On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and improving software applications and systems. You will work closely with internal teams, business stakeholders, and technical staff to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused software solutions.


Job Title: Software Engineer, Full-Time Position
ANZSCO Code: 261313 Software Engineer
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 38 hours per week
Work Location: In person
Industry: Software Development / IT Services / Digital Solutions


Key Responsibilities
The successful candidate will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, frontend and backend development, database integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing system maintenance.

Main Duties and Tasks
- Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into software solutions.
- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications, platforms, and system features.
- Develop frontend interfaces using technologies such as JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and application logic using suitable programming languages and frameworks.
- Design, manage, and optimise databases using SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar database systems.
- Develop RESTful APIs and support integration between internal systems and third-party platforms.
- Write clean, efficient, reusable, and maintainable code in accordance with development standards.
- Conduct debugging, troubleshooting, code reviews, and performance optimisation.
- Participate in system design, software architecture planning, and technical documentation.
- Support cloud-based deployment, version control, CI/CD, and DevOps activities using tools such as AWS, Azure, Git, Jenkins, or similar.
- Work with product managers, designers, business users, and technical teams to deliver software that meets business objectives.
- Prepare user guides, technical documentation, release notes, and system support materials.
- Maintain data security, system reliability, and compliance with workplace policies and procedures.
- Support ongoing system upgrades, enhancements, and legacy system improvements.

Essential Requirements
- Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience as a Software Engineer, Software Developer, Full-Stack Developer, or in a similar software development role.
- Experience in frontend development using JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, or similar technologies.
- Experience with backend development, APIs, databases, and system integration.
- Knowledge of programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar.
- Experience with SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or other relational database systems.
- Understanding of software development lifecycle, system design, testing, debugging, and deployment processes.
- Experience using Git, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools, or DevOps practices is highly regarded.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical troubleshooting skills.
- Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced technical environment.


If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position and assess your suitability for the role.

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Systems Test Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our technology systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions. This role suits a methodical and analytical professional with a strong technical background in software and systems testing, a commitment to quality assurance best practices, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Specify, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test scripts, and test cases to validate the behaviour, functionality, and integrity of ICT systems across multiple platforms and environments.
- Identify, diagnose, and document functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, quality standards, and compliance guidelines to ensure systems perform to specification.
- Design and conduct regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure new and updated systems meet defined requirements and business needs.
- Utilise automated test software and frameworks to streamline testing processes, improve test coverage, and increase efficiency across the software development lifecycle.
- Produce clear and comprehensive defect reports, test summary reports, and related quality assurance documentation, ensuring traceability from requirements through to test outcomes.
- Perform systems architecture reviews and assessments, evaluating current and future hardware and software configurations, and contributing recommendations to inform strategic technical direction.
- Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and project managers to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and support timely delivery of system releases.
- Create, review, and maintain technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, instructional materials, technical specifications, and maintenance inventory records.
- Analyse test results and defect trends to identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the organisation.
- Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing a quality assurance perspective throughout the development cycle.
- Assess risks associated with system changes and releases, providing input into risk mitigation strategies and supporting informed decision-making across project and operational teams.
- Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of testing tools, methodologies, and frameworks to ensure the organisation's testing capabilities remain current and effective.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
- Demonstrated experience in ICT systems testing, quality assurance, or a closely related technical role, with a solid understanding of the software development and systems engineering lifecycle.
- Proficiency in writing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts across functional, non-functional, and regression testing scenarios.
- Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable technologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system faults and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including test reports, defect logs, operational guides, and system specifications.
- Familiarity with agile and DevOps methodologies and the ability to integrate quality assurance activities into iterative development workflows.
- Solid understanding of systems architecture, network infrastructure, and software integration concepts relevant to enterprise ICT environments.
- Competency with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and organisational skills, with a strong commitment to delivering quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.
## Preferred Qualifications
- ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or above) or an equivalent recognised qualification in software testing or quality assurance.
- Experience working in regulated industries or environments with strict compliance, security, or governance requirements, such as government, finance, or healthcare.
- Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity testing principles, including vulnerability assessments and secure coding practices.
- Experience with cloud-based environments and platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and an understanding of how they impact testing strategies.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and associated tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Bamboo.
- A postgraduate qualification or additional certifications in project management, IT governance, or related fields, such as ITIL or PRINCE2, would be highly regarded.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking team that values technical excellence and continuous improvement, where your contributions directly shape the quality of systems used across the organisation.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and attendance at relevant conferences and events.
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with options for hybrid work arrangements, supporting a healthy work-life balance without compromising on career growth.
- Work on complex, large-scale ICT projects that offer genuine variety and the opportunity to deepen your expertise across diverse technologies and industries.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression within a growing organisation that invests in its people.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Project Engineer – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $100,000 – $140,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Project Engineer to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Project Engineer, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering engineering projects across mining, oil and gas, and industrial sectors. You will work closely with project managers, clients, engineers, supervisors, and site personnel to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with contractual and engineering requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Plan, coordinate, and manage engineering projects from commencement through to completion.
•	Review engineering drawings, specifications, contracts, and project documentation.
•	Prepare project schedules, work programs, budgets, cost estimates, and resource plans.
•	Coordinate engineering, fabrication, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.
•	Monitor project progress and ensure milestones, budgets, and quality standards are achieved.
•	Liaise with clients, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal project teams.
•	Identify technical issues and provide practical engineering solutions to minimise project risks.
•	Ensure compliance with Australian Standards, engineering specifications, contractual obligations, and company procedures.
•	Prepare technical reports, progress reports, project documentation, and engineering correspondence.
•	Assist with tender preparation, cost planning, and contract administration.
•	Conduct site inspections and support project delivery teams to ensure safe and efficient execution of works.
•	Promote and maintain compliance with workplace health, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, Structural, or related discipline).
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience as a Project Engineer or in a similar engineering role.
•	Experience delivering mining, industrial, fabrication, maintenance, shutdown, or construction projects.
•	Strong knowledge of project planning, engineering principles, contract administration, and project delivery.
•	Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
•	Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organisational skills.
•	Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced project environment.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $100,000 – $140,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing professional development and career progression.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.
